title: Draft: Protobuf: call json dissector for JSON mapping view
description:
The original way of Protobuf-to-JSON Mapping, which adds JSON strings line by line, seems inelegant, and not inconvenient to copy (mentioned in https://gitlab.com/wireshark/wireshark/-/issues/17797#note_1176039581).

This MR makes the JSON generated from Protobuf as a new tvb, and reuses the JSON dissector to display JSON content in packet detail panel. That also makes you easy to copy JSON content by right-click menu "Copy->...as Printable Text". In addition, you can expand and collapse JSON items in the tree.

If the new "Display JSON in raw form" of JSON dissector from MR !9119 is merged, that will look like:

![protobuf_json_mapping_enhancement](/uploads/e51b50878b18b90c7fd454d38e82709f/protobuf_json_mapping_enhancement.jpg)
